d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GlazedF: A tart with more fruit than structure, which is the correct ratio.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Pickled: Pickled so hard that it has outlived the colony's first leader.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HerbRoa: Potatoes that have been to a garden party and brought back a plant.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BerryAn: Crunchy, healthy and extremely not what the raiders asked for.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TeaSmok: Smoked with tea, because why shouldn't the meat relax too.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_StrawFl: Flat, honest, and a little bit sandy. Like the desert it came from.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CactusF: Sweet and spiny, just like your best friend.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Greenfr: A stew so green that the muffalo took offence.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Strawfl: Dumplings from the wasteland, filled with something that may have been meat.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_DesertB: Liquid and solid breakfast, in the right order.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Grilled: A whole fish, a little salt, and no apology to the fish.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishSte: Anything that swims ends up here sooner or later.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedF: Fillet of the day, smoked until it forgot the river.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Sashimi: Raw fish, thinly sliced, and a tiny moral dilemma.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishTac: Fish in a tortilla, delivered by a colonist who ran the whole way.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Soup.label: soup bowl
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Soup.description: A bowl of something hot and wet. Eaten with a spoon, a prayer, or both.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Stew.label: stew pot
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Stew.description: A heavy bowl of slow-cooked stew, steaming with the promise of a second helping.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Grill.label: grill platter
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Grill.description: Meat that has had a conversation with an open flame and lost.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Noodles.label: noodle bowl
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Noodles.description: A tangle of noodles in a bowl. Slurping is not optional.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Rice.label: rice dish
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Rice.description: A mound of rice with opinions, served on a plate with a fork nobody asked for.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Bake.label: baked dish
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Bake.description: Something that went into the oven as ingredients and came out as a decision.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Fry.label: fried plate
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Fry.description: Golden, crunchy and wildly unhealthy. Exactly what the colony ordered.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Salad.label: salad plate
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Salad.description: A cold plate with a lot of leaves, very little remorse, and a short shelf life.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Raw.label: raw plate
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Raw.description: Thinly sliced, expensively arranged and absolutely not cooked.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Breakfast.label: breakfast plate
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Breakfast.descriptio: A plate that says the day has started, whether you like it or not.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Dessert.label: dessert dish
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_Dessert.description: A small, sweet reward for surviving another day on the Rim.
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_StreetFood.label: street food tray
d:ThingDef/HH_Plate_StreetFood.descripti: Hot, handheld and best eaten standing up, quickly, with one eye on the exits.
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_Cooking_L1.label: home cooking
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_Cooking_L1.descr: Stews, porridge, fried eggs and everything else a hungry colony cooks without a recipe book. Known from the start.
d:HediffDef/HH_WellFed.label: well fed
d:HediffDef/HH_WellFed.description: A proper dish keeps the stomach quiet for longer: hunger falls slower while this lasts.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_PrepCounter.label: prep counter
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_PrepCounter.descri: A scarred counter with a cutting board, a good knife and a drainage groove nobody asked about. Chop, slice and carve here; other devices of a dish must stand close by.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_StockPot.label: stock pot
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_StockPot.descripti: A big iron pot over a wood fire. Simmers, boils and stews anything that was ever alive. Burns wood while it works.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Grill.label: grill
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Grill.description: A grate over glowing coals. Meat goes on raw, comes off with opinions. Burns wood while it works.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Oven.label: oven
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Oven.description: A stone and iron oven for roasting and baking. Takes a long time to heat and a short time to ruin dinner. Burns wood while it works.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_WokStation.label: wok station
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_WokStation.descrip: A round-bottomed pan over a roaring flame. Everything is stir-fried here, including the cook's eyebrows. Burns wood while it works.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_DeepFryer.label: deep fryer
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_DeepFryer.descript: A vat of boiling oil with a basket and a strong sense of its own danger. Electric. Catches fire more readily than anything else in the kitchen.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Smoker.label: smoker
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Smoker.description: A tall wooden cabinet that turns meat into something that lasts. Needs wood chips, patience and no neighbours. Burns wood while it works.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Steamer.label: steamer
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_Steamer.descriptio: Stacked bamboo baskets over a pot of boiling water. Soft, gentle and almost impossible to burn. Burns wood while it works.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_DoughBench.label: dough bench
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_DoughBench.descrip: A heavy bench with a flour-dusted top. Rice and corn are pounded into dough here, which is cheaper than therapy.
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_ColdStation.label: cold station
d:ThingDef/HH_Station_ColdStation.descri: A chilled counter that keeps salads crisp and desserts firm. Electric.
